steps.content: More and more monsters appear. They are not very strong, but there is an indescribable oddness about them.
Unlike conventional Corruptors, these new types emerging from DisMyth have digitalized apparitions. Simply being near them clouds your mind.

All the Corruptors you've encountered in the past, regardless of their form, show Mania-induced insanity, a strong desire for violence and destruction, and are particularly aggressive towards humans. But these...

These "Corruptors" before you, despite the shape and form you know all too well, are remarkably quiet in their actions. Swift, subdued, and precisely pinpointing their target, they show no hostility towards you, and only aim to kill the girl behind you in the quickest way possible. Their rationality makes them harder to deal with.

You're accustomed to facing hostility head-on to protect yourself. But when it comes to protecting someone else, your instincts and self-defense reflexes fall short. The enemy takes advantage of them, overwhelming you with feints and deceptive moves.
There must be a more formidable force behind you all... To hunt down one person like this... is she that much of a threat? Or does she know too much?
I won't let you succeed.
[Release the shackles]

In front of the shackles, a giant rift breaks through space, tearing at your vision. The web of light threads drowns out the familiar urban landscape, rendering everything surreal. You feel your stamina and mental energy rapidly depleting.
At this moment, someone tugs at your clothes, and you hear her disjointed voice from behind.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: ...That's enough.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: No one... can... do it alone.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Let me... do it... with you.

The person behind you moves closer, one hand supporting your waist, the other gently holding your weakening arm. You feel something flowing from her palm, seeping into your body, gathering in your hand, and infusing into the shackles.
Then...
[Glitch effect]

A halo rapidly expands from your hand and cuts through all the Corruptors around you. They halt abruptly, their dark bodies flickering with specks of light. Then, they shake and swell, flashing countless familiar faces in the blink of an eye, unable to move forward.

A second halo follows closely, this time cutting through each rift around you, dispersing the web threads that divide your world. Countless specks of light fall and transform into characters, then quickly dissolve. A deep, resonant rumble echoes in your mind. Then, a third ring...
When the third halo explodes, there are no more threats around you. It just flies across the sky, kindling brilliant fireworks wherever it goes.
(Transition)
You fail to utter this question.
She steps in front of you, gently presses a fingertip to your lips, silencing your words, and closes her eyes.
A bizarre feeling slowly flows through your body, like countless tiny electric currents rolling into you and converging at where her finger rests, before flowing into her fingertip.
This lasts until she opens her eyes again and smiles at you.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: ...See, now I can speak properly.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Hello, dear Chief. My name is 000. It was no easy task to see you in person, but I had a lot of fun. Can you stay with me... a little longer?
Your companions haven't arrived yet, and the next battle hasn't started either. Besides, fireworks must be a rare sight so high up here...
She turns and walks towards the grand, illuminated city.
The wind stops, and the noise fades for the moment. You can clearly hear her voice.
Can you stay with me to watch it all?
Flickering fireworks illuminates her profile, outlining her features in lights and shadows. Beneath the spectacular display, she seems like an illusion.
